name: registry-match-fuses-on-not-mountable
description: The one place a server keeping no durable record answers something other than NOT_SUPPORTED for a read it cannot mount: the blueprint registry MATCHED the caller's key, so what the read found is a component it has no channel to deliver. The answer is NOT_MOUNTABLE — and because the match depends on the key rather than on the row, it is still identical for a refused read and a miss. This server wires NO delivery channel at all, which is what makes undeliverability follow from the declared shape rather than from any one implementation's choice about how it serves a registry match.
